provenance.notes: Clean-room match-request reply derived from the traced ROM parser (M32). Request builder 35ABD2 sends POST /cgi-bin/dark/nph-reqmatch.cgi with X-SWAN-MTCH-ID/NAME/LVL/RETRY headers (272 bytes native). Reply status is parsed by 35AEB9 (finds HTTP/1. and reads the decimal code); 302 means retry-later, anything else continues. MTCH headers are found case-insensitively by 35AF6C (requires the X-SWAN- prefix immediately before the name and a colon after it); numbers are parsed by 35AFA8/35AF2D, which stop only at space or LF, so every value line ends with LF (a bare CR would corrupt the value). RETCD 0/1 waits using MTCH-POLINT/MTCH-TIMEOUT (35C386); missing RETCD shows 3598DA 'no opponent' and retries; RETCD 2 stores opponent ID/NAME (URL-decoded by 35AB8A)/LVL/SEED/MATCH/HOST/PATH/ACOUNT/BCOUNT/COUNT (35C3C1..35C474) and the wrapper returns 9. All opponent fields here are newly authored PLACEHOLDER values; no original server data, ranking, or battle pairing is reconstructed. Original matchmaking policy and the nph-match.cgi battle phase remain unknown.
